mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in the federal funds rate above 5.0% signals a tightening monetary cycle that increases discount rates on equity cash flows, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS exceeds 5.0%, or the average return in triggered periods is not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decline in the unemployment rate below 4.0% signals tight labor market conditions that increase wage pressures and inflation expectations, prompting the Fed to maintain restrictive policy and suppressing equity valuations over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX generates positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE < 4.0%, or the return distribution in such periods is not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in residential construction starts above 1.35 million units signals strong household demand and rising inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60-day returns in more than 60% of triggered instances, or the average return in high-HOUST periods is not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in industrial production below 102.0 indicates weakening real economic activity, reducing corporate earnings growth expectations and leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX generates positive 5-day returns in more than 60% of instances when INDPRO < 102.0, or the average return in such periods is not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in both residential construction starts and real personal consumption expenditures signals strong aggregate demand, which increases inflation expectations and triggers a forward-looking equity sell-off over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of joint-triggered instances, or the interaction effect is not statistically significant (interaction term p > 0.05 in regression model).

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in the CPI inflation rate above 3.1% combined with a stable federal funds rate signals persistent inflation, prompting the Fed to delay rate cuts and leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX generates positive 60-day returns in more than 60% of instances where CPIAUCSL > 313.0 and FEDFUNDS <= 5.5%, or the interaction term in a predictive model has a negative IC < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in non-farm payroll employment above 158,700 thousand signals strong labor market demand, which increases wage pressures and inflation expectations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of periods with PAYEMS > 158700.0, or the average return is not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in real GDP growth below 2.0% annualized signals a weakening economy, prompting the Fed to cut rates and leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60-day returns in more than 60% of periods with GDPC1 < 2.0% annualized, or the average return in such periods is not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05).
